Rei Shiotani

"Like I keep telling you—the piston cup's shot. Plain old age."

A high school boy with a deep love for replica guns.

He has an exceptional eye for things, but the one thing he cannot read is the warmth people give off.

Satsuki Aihara

"A backwater. That's what I call this place."

A woman working at the harbor depot, looking somehow worn out.

A young carer who looks after her divorced mother; attentive and dependable.

Yuzen Momoki

"I've chased that back all my life. Wanting to catch up to it."

The man who hired Rei — the one standing at the top of the harbor depot.

Still young, he strives to one day catch up to the father he respects.

Kotaro Tsurube

"No need to freeze up. Believe it or not, we're all about your age."

The man who invited Rei to the part-time job at the depot.

Bright and comical — the depot's mood-maker.

Peko Tanaka

The daughter of Koji Tanaka, the depot's investor.

Haughty, yet somehow impossible to hate.

Monsters keep bursting out of the eggs. A giant flyswatter SPLATS down, flying enemies buzz all over the place, fire-breathing penguins puff out flames, a wizard suddenly turns into a cow with a “moo,” and deer-riding enemies come galloping in… And the skills they use? You can steal them and use them yourself!

                                     

In Egg Rush, every egg is a fluffy mystery box.

You never know what monster will pop out next, what event will trigger, or what loot will drop.

The only sure thing: the chaos keeps growing, you keep getting stronger… or the Boss does.

                                     

A giant flyswatter SPLATS down, flying enemies buzz everywhere, fire-breathing penguins puff flames, wizards suddenly turn into cows with a “moo,” and deer-riding enemies come charging in… Every run brings fresh chaos.

                                     

Push forward side-scrolling style, crack eggs to clear out enemies, cast summon skills, and grab loot. The action is non-stop and pops off the whole way.

                                     

You don’t just fight, you summon! Call out fluffy plush buddies and let them charge around for you.

                                     

Different choices lead to different growth paths. Every run feels like opening a mystery box, and you build your very own setup.

                                     

Defeat a mini boss and it drops random loot. Lucky or unlucky? You’ll only know when you open it.

                                     

When attacked, the Boss drops stat-boosting items too, but they go to the enemy! The more you hit it, the stronger it gets.

                                     

The soft, cute look is just a shell.

Cracking eggshells, swarming monsters, flying skills, Boss upgrades…

The real Egg Rush is a wild, fuzzy free-for-all.

From egg to battlefield

Eggs, berries, treasure chests, and bombs fall into the hatchery. Hatch eggs, grow your monster lineup, and watch the basket fill up.

Send your monsters forward

Your monsters advance through the battlefield, fight enemy soldiers, and damage the enemy tower when they reach the far end. Later stages bring tougher defenders, so make use of the different monsters in your lineup.

Earn, upgrade, advance

Use the rewards from shipping and combat to adjust your egg output and strengthen your skill tree. Improve your hatching and fighting loop as you push deeper into the stages.

Features

  • A hatchery where eggs and items tumble and pile up
  • Five monster species and a battlefield full of enemy soldiers
  • Per-monster egg output settings and a branching skill tree
  • Treasure chests, bombs, and berries mixed into the action

🔧 Open Your Own Electronics Repair Shop!

Electronics Repair Shop is a repair and business simulation game where you fix broken devices, buy and sell used electronics, and grow your own shop.

Start small and get to work at your repair bench. Open devices, find the source of each fault, and use your earnings to invest in equipment and develop your business.

🛠️ Open Devices, Find Faults, Make Repairs!

A device that looks fine on the outside may hide a problem inside. Inspect its parts, identify faulty components, and get it working again.

Remove damaged parts, install suitable replacements, and test your repairs. Finding out what went wrong and fixing it with your own hands is all part of the job.

💰 Give Used Electronics a Second Chance!

There are opportunities beyond the repair bench, too. Browse the second-hand market, buy affordable devices, and prepare them for resale.

Look for repairable products, consider the costs, and turn your purchases into profit. You decide which devices to buy and which are worth fixing.

🏪 Invest in Your Shop!

Use the money you earn from repairs and sales to grow your business.

Buy new equipment, expand your workspace, and improve your shop to take on more work. Will you spend your earnings on spare parts, another used device, or your next equipment upgrade?

You decide what comes next for your shop.

📈 Make Repairs and Manage Your Business!

Running a repair shop takes more than technical skills. Focus on repair jobs, explore opportunities in the second-hand market, or combine both.

Plan your purchases, keep track of your expenses, and find your own way to grow your small business.

Mastering the flames is the key to successful alchemy. Each pill comes down to your recipe, ingredients, and control of the furnace temperature. Steady heating brings reliable returns, while perfect timing can produce an immortal pill with incredible stats! Even failure comes with no real setback—JieHui and returned ingredients are yours to keep. Tweak your recipe and try again; your next batch might just be the breakthrough you need.

Every mortal life eventually comes to an end. But death is never the end—your lifetime of cultivation becomes permanent DaoHen, which can unlock talents in the Reincarnation Tree and carry your legacy into a new life. Experiment with different growth paths, refine your pill builds, and shape your own cultivation legacy across countless reincarnations.

What starts as brewing pills one batch at a time soon grows into a thriving alchemy business, with minions tending your herbs and taking care of the tedious work. Automatic ingredient loading and precise heat control let you spend less time tending the furnace and more time growing your cultivation. Step away whenever you like—your spirit stones and cultivation progress will keep piling up while you’re gone, waiting for you when you return.

Gather rare materials and unlock a wealth of recipes as you expand a humble alchemy room into a grand cultivation abode. But spirit stones are only a means to an end. Your true goal is to find the legendary recipe that can defy the heavens and extend your life. Reincarnate, break through the limits of mortality, and refine your way to ascension and immortality.

Elven Huntress: Sunveil is an atmospheric third-person 3D action RPG with exploration, loot, crafting, and character customization.

Play as an elven huntress, explore fantasy locations through magical portals, fight orcs, humans, and the undead, find rare equipment, and improve your character.

Explore a fantasy world

Travel through the portal to a variety of locations:

  • Snow-covered mountain ruins.

  • Coniferous forests.

  • Ancient fortresses.

  • Dungeons.

  • Dark lands of the undead.

Fight enemies, gather resources, unlock new equipment, and improve your character.

Create your own elven huntress

Use the character creator, customize your appearance, and collect unique sets of equipment.

Sunveil Fortress

Sunveil is your main hub and progression center.

Between raids, upgrade your fortress and unlock new features:

  • Weapon and armor crafting.

  • Alchemy and potion making.

  • Equipment transmogrification.

  • Item enhancement with runes.

  • Shop.

  • Character progression system.

Elven Huntress: Sunveil is an atmospheric single-player adventure with a beautiful protagonist, enjoyable progression, and a world you'll want to return to.

Ember Camp Knight

Ember Camp Knight is a fast and snappy quarter-view 2.5D pixel art action game — set in a dungeon no one built for you.

Jump in anytime for quick, satisfying action — think of it as a "popcorn flick" you can play.

A single descent takes about 5–10 minutes. Death is never the end — your progress stays. Regroup at camp, then descend deeper.

■ Punchy Quarter-View Action

Face your enemies in fast-paced combat. Dodge, dive in, and unleash a flurry of attacks. Every floor brings new enemies — reading their patterns and breaking through is the key to survival.

■ Three Paths of Progression

  • Stage passive skills — Pick 1 of 3 at every stage and fight a different way each descent

  • Permanent trainer skills — Learn a technique once, keep it forever

  • Persistent gear upgrades — Enhance your weapon, armor, and potions with upgrade materials

Permanent progression that survives death, and fresh builds every descent — working together.

■ A Dungeon That Changes as You Descend

Forest, lava, snowfield — conquer a 4-layer themed dungeon, each floor with its own atmosphere, enemies, and music. Every layer spans 5 stages, and at the deepest point, the final boss awaits.

■ A Camp Inside the Dungeon

Between battles, catch your breath at a campfire deep underground.

  • Merchant — Buy potions and supplies

  • Blacksmith — Upgrade your weapons and armor

  • Trainer — Teach you new techniques

  • Girl — She tends the fire, and asks for nothing

■ A Story Beyond the Action

Beneath the flashy combat, a quiet story flows on.

Why was the dungeon built, and why does the knight descend?

The answer awaits you, in the depths far below.

■ After the Credits

Take on Hard Mode, where enemies hit harder and swarm in greater numbers. Stack up permanent upgrades and chase your perfect build.

EVERY DEFEAT IS A CLUE.

The memories of a fallen civilization are trapped in a field of hostile hexes.

Every encounter is a deterministic autobattler puzzle. Read the enemy, assemble your loadout, forecast the result, and deploy.

Once combat begins, the battle plays itself. There are no mid-battle commands, no reflex tests, and no random combat outcomes.

Your build is the answer. The battlefield is the proof.

BUILD THE PERFECT COUNTER.

A losing build isn't necessarily a dead end.

Combine skills, passives, artifacts, and gear to discover powerful interactions between damage types, status effects, and equipment bonuses.

An enemy that defeats your current loadout might fall to an entirely different combination.

Inspect the forecast. Understand what failed. Change your build.

Turn DEFEAT into VICTORY through strategy.

EVERY ENCOUNTER CHANGES THE RULES.

The strongest build isn't always the right build.

Some enemies are immune to entire damage types. Others demand particular status effects, resist conventional tactics, or change their defenses across multiple boss phases.

Master encounters that challenge you to rethink your approach.

Solve the enemy in front of you and not just the last one you defeated.

CONQUER ONCE. AUTOMATE PROGRESSION.

Once you've conquered an encounter, put your winning strategy to work.

Spend Exploration Points to activate Auto-Farm on conquered memories. Assign saved loadouts to different encounters and let your successful builds generate progression while you focus on the next challenge.

Offline progression means you can leave the game and return to the work your automated builds have accomplished.

Think deeply. Automate intelligently. Return when you're ready.

A WORLD THAT KEEPS CHANGING.

Explore 60+ handcrafted deterministic encounters across a haunted hex map.

Discover new combinations of skills, passives, artifacts, gear, damage types, and status effects. Maintain up to six saved loadouts for different strategies and automated farming assignments.

And when you believe you've mastered the map, the Second Reading changes the rules again with new encounter challenges, additional ranks, resources, and a deeper final confrontation.

The more you understand, the more possibilities emerge.

Solve the fight. Conquer the hex. Automate what you've mastered.
